# app/vendor/fs

Loose files copied verbatim into the ROM's DragonFS root by build_rom.py
(only when core/filesystem/ does not already have them).

* intro/dragon1..4.sprite -- the four line-art layers (head, body, tail,
  wordmark) of the "made with libdragon" boot animation (see
  core/src/port/pd_intro.c), I8 sprites generated by `mksprite` from
  core/assets/intro/dragon*.png.  That art is MIT-licensed (see NOTICE).
  Regenerate with:
      cd core && libdragon exec mksprite -f I8 -o filesystem/intro \
                 assets/intro/dragon1.png assets/intro/dragon2.png \
                 assets/intro/dragon3.png assets/intro/dragon4.png
      cp core/filesystem/intro/dragon*.sprite app/vendor/fs/intro/
